decisions.decision: F3 keeps the original rule and changes only the anchor

decisions.decision: Kept F5's derivation inside canvasReading by synthesizing the pendingAsk pointer

decisions.decision: Added a fourth F5 condition the diagnosis did not have — the run must still be live

decisions.decision: Fixed F7 with the Builder's kbTools rule copied verbatim rather than a new one
